map.口令强度按 7 项加 1：长度≥8、≥12、含小写、含大写、含数字、含符号；得分: Password strength scores 7 items with 1 point each: length ≥8, ≥12, contains lowercase, contains uppercase, contains digits, contains symbols; score ≤2 is weak, ≤4 is medium, otherwise strong. Generated passwords default to 16 characters from a character set with confusing characters removed:
map.字母+数字+符号（约 56 个字符）。加密为逐字节 password[i] XO: letters + digits + symbols (about 56 characters). Encryption is byte-wise password[i] XOR key[i % key.length] followed by Base64.
map.abc123 仅含小写+数字得 2 分→弱；Abcd1234! 含大小写+数字+: abc123 has only lowercase + digits and scores 2 → weak; Abcd1234! has upper and lower case + digits + symbols + length ≥8 and scores 6 → strong. The encryption key pw XORs the plaintext byte by byte before Base64; decryption requires the same master password.
